## UI system checklist

- [ ] I reused an existing primitive or product pattern before creating a local equivalent.
- [ ] New shared variants are represented on `/ui`.
- [ ] Loading, empty, error, disabled, and validation states were considered where applicable.
- [ ] Keyboard navigation and visible focus were checked.
- [ ] Standard desktop and narrow mobile layouts were checked.
- [ ] `pnpm ui:colors` passes; intentional domain or visualization colors are documented.
- [ ] Relevant functional and screenshot tests were updated.
